cohort: The study included 581 singleton pregnancies in women with TS/CTD, matched with 5777 unexposed pregnancies, all at >=22 weeks gestation in Sweden between 2001 and 2021.
finding: Maternal TS/CTD is associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes and cesarean section, but not with increased risks of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Maternal TS/CTD was associated with significantly increased risks of elective and emergency cesarean section.
